recipe.visualDefinition: A textured, mixed-media composition featuring a cowboy on horseback herding cattle, rendered in a desaturated watercolor style with heavy ink splatters and ornate, vintage-inspired typography framed by filigree.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with heavy grounding at the bottom
Typography anchored at the top within a decorative flourish
Watercolor bleeds connecting the central figure to the background edges
High contrast between the dark ink splatters and the cream parchment background
coreInvariants: Watercolor texture with visible brush strokes and drips
Ornate Victorian-style filigree surrounding the primary text
Action-oriented pose of the horse and rider

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The cowboy and horse are the central focus, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame at a medium-large scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, dense watercolor mass at the center of the horse and rider.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large ornate text at the top, down the decorative ribbon, to the dynamic action of the horse and cow below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant cream-colored negative space at the top corners and edges to balance the central complexity.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between dark ink and light background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and muted teals

letterConstructionRules: Integrated into a symmetrical filigree ornament
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial and terminal letters feature extended flourishes that merge with decorative scrollwork

composition.position: Centered on ribbon below display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate, high-contrast display serif paired with a clean, geometric slab serif for legibility on the ribbon.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary swashes and high-contrast serifs

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a watercolor painting of a cowboy on a horse herding a cow. Use a palette of sepia, cream, and muted teal. Incorporate heavy ink splatters, visible brush strokes, and a textured parchment background. Leave the top third relatively clear for text, but include a symmetrical filigree flourish at the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary display text in a dark brown Victorian swash serif, centered within the top filigree. Below that, add a curved teal ribbon containing the subtitle in a cream-colored slab serif.

verificationChecks: Is the watercolor texture visible and organic?
Does the typography feel integrated with the filigree?
Is the color palette restricted to earth tones and teal?
Is the action of the horse and rider dynamic?

adjustableVariables: Level of distress on the typography
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for seamless blending between the subject and the watercolor background.
Ensure the text on the ribbon follows the curve naturally.
Verify that the ink splatters do not obscure the legibility of the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Western Subject] with [Watercolor/Ink Splatter Style] + [Victorian Filigree Typography] using a [Sepia/Teal Palette].
